subject: Request: CAIQ/SIG artifacts for ephemeral KEK eviction & TLS wrapping proofs
messages:
From: Ivy Patel <ivy.patel@fincore.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: security_ops@fincore.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ/SIG - artifacts request: ephemeral KEK eviction + TLS wrapping

Marcus,

As part of FinCore's SIG/CAIQ review, we need a focused artifact set demonstrating how Redwood handles ephemeral KEK eviction and TLS wrapping for in-transit envelope keys. Specifically can you provide the following: 

- Operator access matrix and role separation for KEK generation/eviction (last 12 months)
- HSM attestation or manufacturer report covering the current cluster used for customer KEKs
- Sample rotation timeline (both automated rotation and manual eviction) with sample audit entries
- A small (sanitized) slice of the KMS audit showing a KEK eviction event and the associated TLS wrapping handoff
- Any relevant CAIQ/SIG references (control IDs) that map to these artifacts

We are hoping to ingest the package into our evidence tracker by EOW (next Friday). If you need to break this up, confirm what you can share first. Also tell us whether the KEK eviction is logged as a discrete event vs inferred from operator actions.

Thanks,
Ivy Patel
Senior Security Engineer, FinCore
ivy.patel@fincore.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ivy Patel <ivy.patel@fincore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ/SIG - artifacts request: ephemeral KEK eviction + TLS wrapping

Ivy — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the artifacts you listed. Quick summary of what we'll deliver and an ETA: 

- Operator access matrix (redacted): includes operator roles, MFA enforcement timestamps, and last operator-initiated eviction event — ETA: 48 hours
- HSM attestation (vendor-signed PDF) covering the cluster in production — ETA: 72 hours (need to pull from vendor vault)
- Rotation timeline/playbook (automated + manual): we will include our runbook excerpts plus a sample play-by-play from a scheduled rotation — ETA: 48 hours
- KMS audit slice: sanitized CSV of an eviction event and TLS wrapping handshake markers (we'll obfuscate customer identifiers) — ETA: 72 hours
- Mapping doc: CAIQ/SIG control IDs -> artifact filenames — ETA: 48 hours

Can you confirm the minimum acceptable redaction policy (e.g., replace tenant IDs with "T-REDACT-##" vs full GUID masking)? Also, who should receive the vendor HSM attestation if there are NDA requirements?

Assigning Marissa to collect the logs and Jonas to generate the mapping doc. We'll send a consolidated package and a Drive folder link once complete.

Regards,
Marcus
Director, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ivy Patel <ivy.patel@fincore.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ/SIG - artifacts request: ephemeral KEK eviction + TLS wrapping

Ivy — moving this forward. Attached are initial stubs: rotation-playbook-v2.pdf (excerpts), kek-eviction-log-sample.csv (sanitized). 

Notes on contents: 
- kek-eviction-log-sample.csv: shows an operator-initiated eviction at 2026-08-29T02:14:03Z. We replaced tenant GUIDs with T-REDACT-01. Columns: event_ts, event_type, operator_id, key_id, wrap_status, tls_handshake_marker.
- rotation-playbook-v2.pdf: contains the automated rotation schedule (30/90/365 day tiers), pre-checks, operator checklist for manual eviction, and rollback guidance.

Quoting Marcus's question about redaction: our standard is GUID->T-REDACT-## unless the customer requires a stricter mask. Let us know if FinCore needs full GUID hashes (sha256) instead.

Drive link to a holding folder (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyZqExampleLinkForArtifacts

Attachments: rotation-playbook-v2.pdf (excerpt), kek-eviction-log-sample.csv

— Marissa
Security Compliance Program
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ivy Patel <ivy.patel@fincore.com>, security_ops@fincore.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Delivery: KEK eviction + TLS wrapping artifact package (CAIQ/SIG mapping)

Ivy / FinCore team —

Per our plan, we've assembled the requested evidence bundle and uploaded it to the Drive folder linked below. Contents attached / available: 

- rotation-playbook-v2.pdf (runbook excerpts and timeline)
- hsm-attestation-2026-07.pdf (vendor-signed)
- kek-eviction-log-sample.csv (sanitized sample showing operator eviction + wrap marker)
- kms-audit-snapshot-20260829.json (sample event stream, sanitized)
- caiq_sig_mapping.csv (control ID -> artifact filename mapping)

Delivery notes / clarifications: 
- Eviction representation: KEK eviction shows up as a discrete audit event with event_type="KEY_EVICT" in our KMS; the subsequent envelope key wrapping handshake is correlated via the tls_handshake_marker field in the audit entry. We've included one end-to-end example in kek-eviction-log-sample.csv.
- Redaction: we used the T-REDACT-## convention. If you need hashed GUIDs, confirm and we'll regenerate the JSON/CSV slices with sha256 masks.
- HSM attestation: vendor document includes model/serial range and FIPS status; if FinCore needs the vendor NDA routing, let us know who to send it to.

Related artifacts and links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XyZqExampleLinkForArtifacts (contains all files above)
Jira: SEC-4821 (internal tracking)
DocuSign envelope: envelope-0a1b2c3d4e (if you require an access agreement)

Please confirm receipt and whether the package meets the CAIQ/SIG control mapping you need. Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through the sample logs.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
